paper_title: Tight Lower Bound on the Probability of a Binomial Exceeding its Expectation
text:
\begin{lemma}[A binomial CDF bound at $p=1/m$]
Let $m\geq2$ and let $X\sim B(m,1/m)$. Then
\[
\mathbb{P}(X\leq1)\leq\frac34.
\]
\end{lemma}
